approved_records.basis: Export report bound to WO-COMMONS-FIRST-EXPORT-01A; it reports the origin of this package.
Release metadata source; it declares source_attribution and the originating owner role for this package.

rule: A repository name disclosed as the origin of a release (source_attribution.public_origin_name) may appear only in that package's PROVENANCE.json, in its release manifests and clearance receipts under releases/<package>/<version>/, and in the exact files listed in approved_records. Approved records are exact paths, never directory prefixes. The name is matched as Miskatonic-System/<name>, as the bare name and as its underscore form. Names of other organization repositories may not appear anywhere.
